name: 负重训练背心贴身稳定款
description: 白底加剖面讲结构，四格场景讲百搭，尺寸与空白背书收口

styleLock.direction: premium athletic-training commerce, calm studio packshots plus warm real-life training frames
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless cool white #FFFFFF for the packshot, bone warm-grey #EFEAE4 and light neutral #F4F2F0 panels for infographic frames, sunlit interior #F1ECE6 and pale concrete #C9C2BB for lifestyle, dark charcoal #2F3336 reserved for one macro
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with a front-left key, fill card on the shadow side and soft contact shadows; lifestyle frames use warm directional daylight at 4200K to 5500K with the same shadow direction as the props; texture reads come from a soft skimming sweep, never from harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte bone-grey board #EFEAE4 for flat lays, matte concrete and timber for lifestyle, dark seamless #2F3336 under macro
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one short headline plus at most five label chips, all in charcoal #26282A with a single accented word in #E4572E; no dense body copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and dot-anchor leader lines in #E4572E, flat, no gradients, no 3D
styleLock.presentationRules: product stays upright and symmetrical, ghost-mannequin or neck-down cropped wear only, consistent strap and closure placement across the set, cutaway panels drawn as a clean section rather than a damaged garment
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or mismatched shadow direction
no visible faces, brand marks, certificates or rendered numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium athletic-training ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool white #FFFFFF, bone warm-grey #EFEAE4, charcoal text #26282A and one training-orange accent #E4572E; neutral studio temperature with bright even high-key key light from the front-left, fill card on the shadow side and soft contact shadows, warm directional daylight only in lifestyle frames; modern geometric sans-serif with one short headline and no more than five label chips; thin single-weight line icons and dot-anchor leader lines in #E4572E; clean high-end sportswear product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright symmetrical product angle and scale, ghost-mannequin or neck-down cropped wear only; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼赢下点击，用干净正立面交代整体轮廓与前扣结构。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level front view on an invisible ghost-mannequin form, full silhouette inside frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow below
shots.whitespace: none; even clean margins on all four sides, no copy area reserved
shots.promptTemplate: Clean marketplace packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level front view mounted on an invisible ghost-mannequin form so both padded shoulder panels, the front closure strap and the lower hem read as one symmetrical silhouette, nothing cropped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio light with a front-left softbox key and a fill card on the shadow side, plus a soft contact shadow that grounds the product. Seamless cool white background #FFFFFF with an even tone edge to edge. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace reserved for copy. Square 1:1 crop. Negative: no model, no hands, no props, no in-image text, no badge, no watermark, no fake logo, no product floating without a contact shadow, no clipped straps, no grey cast on the white background.

shots.intent: 用一屏剖切结构讲清它为什么穿着训练，替代空洞形容词。
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even high-key top light with a soft skimming sweep from the upper left that reads quilting and weave
shots.background: bone warm-grey #EFEAE4 panel with oversized ghosted letterforms in #E3DCD4 bleeding off the right edge
shots.props: five rounded label chips in #FFFFFF with dot-anchor leader lines in #E4572E
shots.whitespace: copy lives inside the label rail, no additional empty block
shots.textZone: label rail around the product; headline slot at the bottom third
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce structure infographic of {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product lies open and symmetrical in the centre of the frame with one side panel drawn as a clean cutaway section that reveals the inner weighted fill layer, its channel stitching and the bound edge. Even high-key top light with a soft skimming sweep from the upper left that reads the quilting and the weave without harsh speculars. Background bone warm-grey #EFEAE4 with oversized ghosted letterforms in #E3DCD4 bleeding off the right edge. Five rounded label chips in #FFFFFF hang on thin dot-anchor leader lines in #E4572E, pointing at the shoulder pad, the face fabric, the front buckle, the inner fill layer and the lower elastic edge, each chip reading one short label from 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_5}」 in charcoal #26282A, with one headline line 「{selling_point_1}」 across the lower band. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame and the label rail is the only negative space. Vertical 4:5 crop. Negative: no brand wordmark, no invented material names or percentages, no more than five labels, no dense body text, no unreadable micro type, no torn or damaged look on the cutaway, no human figure, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入日常步道加练的画面，建立场景联想。
shots.camera: low eye-level tracking view with a slight 3/4 turn toward the lens, framed from the collarbone down
shots.lighting: warm late-afternoon daylight from the right around 4200K, long soft directional shadows falling forward on the pavement
shots.background: sunlit path with a pale concrete retaining wall #C9C2BB, out-of-focus ornamental grasses and a timber trunk #8C7457
shots.props: two figures in plain tops, shorts and leggings in muted #6B6E70 and #26282A, one wrist watch
shots.whitespace: none; the figures fill the frame with no reserved copy block
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle training scene: {product} worn over a plain athletic top by two figures walking and light-jogging along a sunlit public path, both framed from the collarbone down so no face appears in frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera at a low eye-level tracking position with a slight 3/4 turn toward the lens, torso and legs visible, heads cropped above the chin line. Warm late-afternoon daylight from the right at roughly 4200K casting long soft directional shadows forward onto the pavement, shadow direction matching every prop. Background pale concrete retaining wall #C9C2BB with out-of-focus ornamental grasses and a timber trunk #8C7457. Props: plain tops, shorts and leggings in muted #6B6E70 and #26282A, one wrist watch, nothing overlapping the front of the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, no reserved copy block. Vertical 4:5 crop. Negative: no identifiable face, no brand mark on apparel, no fused or extra fingers, no exaggerated anatomy, no second identical figure, no text, no watermark, no fake logo, no shadow pointing the wrong way.

shots.intent: 一屏铺开设定范围，让用户确认自己的日常与居家练法都用得上。
shots.camera: four matched panels: left panel straight-on eye-level slight 3/4, top right tile from a high 45-degree angle looking down, middle tile clean 90-degree side profile, bottom tile photographed from behind at shoulder height
shots.lighting: soft daylight key with gentle fill per panel, true contact shadows, warmer indoors and cooler outdoors while keeping one light logic
shots.background: light neutral field #F4F2F0 with thin #FFFFFF gutters, timber floor #C8B39A and pale wall #F1ECE6 inside the tiles
shots.props: one floor mat, one balance trainer dome, one tablet held at the side, all kept clear of the product front
shots.whitespace: panels fill the frame edge to edge, only the gutter band stays clean
shots.textZone: top-left headline block above the large panel, one small chip per tile
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce multi-scene collage of {product}: four matched panels laid out on a light neutral field #F4F2F0 separated by thin #FFFFFF gutters, one large panel on the left and three stacked tiles on the right. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The left panel is photographed straight-on at eye level with a slight 3/4 turn; the top tile from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto a floor mat; the middle tile from a clean 90-degree side profile; the bottom tile from behind at shoulder height. Every figure is cropped below the chin or shown from behind, so no face is identifiable. Soft daylight key with gentle fill and true contact shadows, the indoor tiles reading warmer and the outdoor tile cooler while keeping one light logic. Interior surfaces: timber floor #C8B39A and pale wall #F1ECE6. Props: one floor mat, one balance trainer dome, one tablet held to the side, none covering the front of the product. A short headline 「{selling_point_2}」 sits top-left in charcoal #26282A and three small chips read 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_3}」. The product occupies 40-50% of each panel, and only the gutter band stays clean. Vertical 4:5 crop. Negative: no identifiable face, no repeated identical pose across tiles, no more than four panels, no prop covering the product front, no dense body text, no invented activity or calorie claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no mismatched lighting between tiles.

shots.intent: 用一处真实做工细节替代形容词，撑起品质可信度。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the quilted pad, stitch rows and one closure piece, surface tilted 45 degrees
shots.lighting: soft skimming sweep from the lower left revealing weave and quilting, one controlled highlight, deep falloff
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject, no copy area
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the quilted padded panel, its rows of stitch detailing and one moulded closure piece, the surface tilted 45 degrees to the lens. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field at f/3.2 with the nearest stitch row razor sharp and the far edge falling into clean falloff. A soft skimming sweep of light from the lower left reveals the weave and the foam quilting with one controlled highlight and no blown speculars. Background dark charcoal seamless #2F3336, uncluttered. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with no reserved copy area. Vertical 4:5 crop. Negative: no blurry subject, no pilling fraying or damage, no plastic-looking texture, no duplicated stitching pattern, no hands, no in-image text, no invented material claims, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 回答穿上合不合身、占多大空间，消除下单前最后的疑虑。
shots.camera: two flat lay views photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, front facade larger and reverse panel smaller
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, minimal shadow, straight edges kept true and untapered
shots.background: bone #EDE9E3 panel over a white #FFFFFF field, split on a soft diagonal
shots.props: thin dimension rails with open arrowheads and empty value chips in #FFFFFF
shots.whitespace: right column kept open for one short line, the rest of the field clean
shots.textZone: right column copy block; blank dimension rails bracket the product
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size-spec screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two flat lay views photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, the larger one showing the front facade and a smaller one showing the reverse panel, both upright and centred in their own zones. Even flat high-key lighting with minimal shadow so every straight edge stays true and untapered. Background a bone #EDE9E3 panel over a white #FFFFFF field split on a soft diagonal. Thin dimension rails in #26282A with open arrowheads bracket the height, the width and one shoulder section; each rail ends in an empty value chip in #FFFFFF with no numbers rendered. One short line in the right column reads 「{callout_4}」 in charcoal #26282A with a single accent word in #E4572E. The two views together occupy 45-50% of the frame and the right column stays open for that line. Vertical 4:5 crop. Negative: no measurement figures, no unit labels, no fabricated specifications, no skewed perspective on straight edges, no brand wordmark, no dense body text, no human figure, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 收口降风险：真实居家穿戴加两条留白背书带，把主张留给卖家填。
shots.camera: waist-up framing photographed from a slight low angle, cropped below the chin with one hand on the front closure
shots.lighting: bright soft window daylight from the left at 5500K with a warm bounce card, airy highlights, gentle falloff
shots.background: sunlit home interior with sheer curtain #F1ECE6, out-of-focus foliage and a timber drape #C8B39A
shots.props: one rounded proof band and two laurel brackets around a blank numeral plate, both left empty
shots.whitespace: top proof band and bottom plate are the only reserved blocks
shots.textZone: top rounded proof band and lower centre plate, both carried as empty frames with one placeholder line
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust close for {product} worn in a sunlit home interior, waist-up framing photographed from a slight low angle and cropped below the chin so no face is identifiable, one hand resting on the front closure. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright soft window daylight from the left at 5500K with a warm bounce card, airy highlights and a gentle falloff that keeps the fabric readable. Background sheer curtain #F1ECE6 with out-of-focus foliage and a timber drape #C8B39A. A rounded proof band across the top holds three empty seal frames in #FFFFFF outlined with thin #26282A rules and one short placeholder line reading 「{callout_5}」; near the lower third, two laurel brackets frame a blank numeral plate with no figures rendered. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, and the top band plus lower plate are the only reserved blocks. Vertical 4:5 crop. Negative: no certification marks, no laboratory names, no legal-standard wording, no sales or review figures, no star ratings, no platform badge, no laurel wreath wrapped around a real number, no identifiable face, no invented claims, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底正面无模特幽灵挂拍，可见双肩垫板、胸前插扣束带与一侧拉链小袋；002 居家窗光半身穿戴图，上方背书带内含三份空白文件框与检测机构字样，下方月桂环包围销量数字；003 两名模特林荫步道快走慢跑，左上角品牌字标、下方两行英文标语；004 俯视平铺结构图，一侧剖切露出内部颗粒填充，五个圆角标签分别指向肩垫、面料、胸前扣、下摆松紧与填充层，底部大字标题；005 「1 大 + 3 小」四格用途拼贴，含户外步行、垫上支撑、坐姿转体与室内办公；006 双视图尺寸规格图，带双向尺寸箭头与具体读数，左下有品牌字标与标题。品类判定：穿戴式负重训练背心，用于步行、慢跑、垫上与居家加练，按图判为运动户外-健身训练；源平台类目路径仅作检索提示未采信，也不归服装外穿或医疗器械。已剥离：源品牌字标与系列名、第三方检测与法规字样、销量与社会证明数字、全部英文原句文案、规格图具体尺寸读数、模特面容身份（一律改颈下裁切或背影）、负载档位数字与反光类主张；图内文字仅保留 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位与空白背书框、空白数值条，产品一律 {product} 占位。
